<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>false</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snc_flowops_housekeeping_task</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Update Housekeeping Shift Room Count</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    // Update current staff's shift
    if (!current.assigned_staff.nil()) {
        updateShiftCount(current.assigned_staff.toString());
    }

    // If the task was reassigned, update the previous staff's shift too
    if (previous &&
        !previous.assigned_staff.nil() &&
        previous.assigned_staff.toString() != current.assigned_staff.toString()) {

        updateShiftCount(previous.assigned_staff.toString());
    }


    function updateShiftCount(staffSysId) {

        // Find the housekeeping shift for this staff member
        var shift = new GlideRecord('x_snc_flowops_staff_skill');

        shift.addQuery('staff', staffSysId);
        shift.setLimit(1);
        shift.query();

        if (!shift.next()) {
            gs.info(
                'No Housekeeping Shift found for staff: ' +
                staffSysId
            );
            return;
        }

        /*
         * Count unfinished housekeeping tasks
         * assigned to this staff member.
         */
        var task = new GlideRecord(
            'x_snc_flowops_housekeeping_task'
        );

        task.addQuery('assigned_staff', staffSysId);
        task.addQuery('status', '!=', 'completed');
        task.query();

        var count = task.getRowCount();

        // Update shift count
        shift.setValue(
            'current_open_work_order',
            count
        );

        shift.update();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-13 11:33:49</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>cc2a73eb51ee03107f4405bb1590ec65</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update Housekeeping Shift Room Count</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FlowOps" source="x_snc_flowops">0b213ef1f86203107f4454db1f4116d5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FlowOps">0b213ef1f86203107f4454db1f4116d5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_cc2a73eb51ee03107f4405bb1590ec65</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-16 09:15:32</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=cc2a73eb51ee03107f4405bb1590ec65"/></record_update>
